'''Gwar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was orbited by the the platform [[Supply Base]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Gwar was the site of a [[Battle of Gwar|battle]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Gwar|Gwar]] is a heavy-metal band whose stage shows feature elaborate theatrical violence.
